designs.text: Design 6802 is a soft cream and pista green saree covered in colourful Kashmiri-style prints of flowers, paisleys, deer and figure motifs. It has a wide matching floral border, a rich pallu and an olive green blouse with printed sleeve borders. A good pick for festivals, family functions and party wear customers.

Design 6665 is a soft lavender-grey saree with a gentle sheen, decorated with colourful floral and bird prints in peach, pink and sky blue along the border and pallu. It comes with a matching textured blouse with a printed sleeve edge. A good pick for parties, family functions and festive wear for customers who like light, elegant colours.

This bright pink saree has a neat checks pattern all over, with colourful elephant motifs along the pallu side. The wide yellow border and pallu show bird and flower designs, and it comes with a matching dark pink blouse with a printed sleeve border. A good pick for festivals, weddings and family functions.

Saree design 6729 is a bright mustard yellow saree with a colourful position print of figures, trees and traditional motifs all over. It has a wide red border with blue and green panels, a rich printed pallu and a matching yellow blouse. A good pick for festivals, pujas and family functions.

Design 7417 is a bright red saree covered with cream and gold embroidery in a diamond grid, showing elephant and peacock motifs with touches of blue, green and yellow. It has a scalloped embroidered border and a matching red blouse with worked sleeves and back. A good pick for weddings, bridal wear and festivals.

Design 7230 is a rose pink saree with a soft sheen, covered in golden leaf-shaped embroidered buttas and a rich golden floral scroll border along the edges. The matching pink blouse has the same golden work on the sleeves and back. A good pick for weddings, receptions and festive functions.

Design 6433 is a bright red saree with silver-white embroidered butta motifs and small dotted work all over, finished with a broad matching embroidered border. The red blouse has the same border work on the sleeves and back. A good choice for weddings, festivals and bridal or party wear customers.

Saree design 6500 is a deep maroon saree with light gold embroidery, small diamond-shaped butties across the body and a broad geometric border with detailed pallu work. The matching maroon blouse has elephant motifs on the sleeves and back. It suits weddings, festivals and family functions.

Design 7485 is a sky blue saree with a soft shimmer finish, decorated with large blue flower motifs highlighted with stone work and a neat scalloped embroidered border. It comes with a dark teal blue blouse with small stone dots. A good pick for parties, receptions and festive functions.

Design 7133 is a rich red saree with a smooth, glossy finish and a scalloped cut-work border in golden embroidery with small green floral motifs. It comes with a dark green stitched blouse with all-over floral embroidery. A good pick for weddings, receptions, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 6767 is a rich magenta pink saree with small star-shaped flower butis in light zari-look embroidery spread across the body and pallu. A wide scalloped border in the same work runs along the edges, with a matching pink blouse. It suits weddings, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 7530 is a bright rani pink saree with golden zari embroidered butties spread across the body and a wide zari work border running along the edges and pallu. It comes with a matching pink blouse with zari motifs on the back and sleeves. A good pick for weddings, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 6419 is a bright red saree with light golden zari work butties spread all over the body and pallu, finished with a scalloped zari border. It comes with a matching red blouse with small butties and elbow-length sleeves. A good pick for weddings, festivals and family functions, loved by brides and young women.

Design 6839 is a rich magenta pink saree with a soft sheen, decorated with golden zari paisley and floral butta all over. It has a scalloped zari border and a matching pink blouse with zari work on the sleeves. A good pick for weddings, festivals and party wear customers who like bright, traditional looks.

Design 5373 is a bright rani pink saree with Gujarati work all over, set in a checks pattern with small peacock and floral motifs. It has a broad multicolour border, a rich pallu with dark green panels, and a dark green blouse with matching work. A good pick for weddings, festivals and family functions.

Design 6376 is a bright red saree with a fine golden check pattern all over and a slim golden lace border, finished with tassels on the pallu. It comes with a dark green blouse with light floral embroidery on the sleeves and back. A good pick for festivals, pujas, weddings and family functions.

Design 6956 is a soft pink saree with small embroidered butties all over and a rich scalloped border of floral embroidery in cream, maroon and gold tones. The matching pink blouse has the same butties and embroidered sleeve edges. A graceful choice for weddings, receptions, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 7636 is a bright red saree with white Bandhej dots set inside a golden and white checked Leheriya pattern, finished with a neat embellished scalloped border. It comes with a dark green blouse with stone work on the front and back. A good pick for weddings, festivals, pooja and family functions.

Design 6242 is a bright rani pink saree with small silver-white leaf motifs spread across the body and a wide matching work border with a scalloped edge. It comes with a pink blouse with the same motifs and border on the sleeves. A good pick for weddings, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 7168 is a dusty rose pink saree with a soft sheen, decorated with multicolour floral embroidered butta all over and a broad golden border with a scalloped edge. The matching pink blouse has golden border work on the sleeves and back. A good choice for weddings, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 7428 is a bright red saree with gold and pink floral embroidered butta work all over and a scalloped golden border. The pallu ends in a dark green panel with lattice and flower work, matched with a dark green embroidered blouse. A good pick for weddings, festivals and family functions.

Saree design 7030 is a plain, smooth deep pink (rani) saree with a soft sheen and a neat golden embroidered lace border with a thin green edge. It comes with a matching pink blouse with rich golden embroidery on the neck, front and sleeves. Good for weddings, festivals, parties and family functions.

Saree design 7272 is a bright red saree with peach and green square bandhej-style motifs spread across the body and a slim golden lace border with green edging. It comes with a plain green blouse with matching border on the sleeves. A good pick for festivals, pujas and family functions.

Saree design 7397 is a teal blue saree with cream-gold embroidered butta motifs all over and a scalloped embroidered border with red floral detailing. It comes with a matching teal blouse with small embroidered motifs on the sleeves and back. A good choice for weddings, festivals and party wear customers.

This bright red saree has a neat checks pattern in light golden lines, with small white bandhej-style dots inside each box. It has a slim embroidered border with tassels on the pallu and comes with a yellow blouse with matching border on the sleeves. A good pick for festivals, pooja and family functions.

Design 7484 is a soft pink saree with a gentle shine, decorated with multicolour leaf motifs outlined in stone work and a neat sparkling stone border. It comes with a plain wine-maroon blouse with small stone dots on the back. A good choice for parties, receptions, festivals and family functions.

Saree 7637 comes in a teal blue shade with coral-peach floral patch panels, colourful flower prints and a geometric striped pallu, finished with a scalloped floral border. It is paired with a matching teal blouse with work on the sleeve edges. A good pick for festivals, family functions and party wear customers.

Design 7482 is a soft olive-green saree covered in colourful thread and zari embroidery of peacocks, swans, elephants and flowers, with a scalloped zari border and small mirror-like highlights. The matching blouse has peacock embroidery on the sleeves and back. Ideal for weddings, receptions and festive customers.

Design 7644 is a deep bottle green saree with golden zari and thread paisley motifs spread across the body and pallu, finished with a matching golden embroidered border. The green blouse carries small matching butta work. A good pick for weddings, receptions and festive functions, for customers who like a rich, traditional look.

Design 6870 is a soft pink saree with colourful floral vine embroidery all over, showing pink, white and yellow flowers with green leaves, finished with a neat scalloped edge. It comes with a matching pink blouse with light work. A lovely pick for festive wear, family functions and party customers who like a fresh look.

Design 7260 is a coral peach saree with resham thread embroidery of swans, lotus flowers and leaves in cream, soft pink and light green across the pallu and along the border. The matching blouse carries the same bird and flower work. It suits weddings, receptions and festive functions.

Design 7614 is a bright red saree with golden thread and zari butta motifs spread across the body and a matching embroidered border with small pink touches. It comes with a dark green blouse with embroidered motifs on the sleeves and back. A good pick for weddings, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 7466 is a teal blue saree covered in thread and zari embroidery, with flowering vines, leaves and small deer motifs in gold, peach and orange. It has a golden scalloped zari border and a matching teal blouse with embroidered sleeves and back. A good choice for weddings, receptions and festive functions.

Design 7254 is a soft pink saree with peacock motifs in golden zari and thread work, touched with green and pink, spread across the body and pallu. It has a slim golden striped border and a matching pink blouse with small embroidered motifs. A good choice for weddings, festivals and family functions.

Design 7535 is a bright red saree with golden thread and zari embroidery, with small green highlights in the leaf-shaped butta motifs spread across the body. It has a wide embroidered border and a matching red blouse with small butta work. A good pick for weddings, festivals and bridal-wear customers.

Saree design 7167 is a bright rani pink saree with thread and zari work peacock motifs and small dots all over, finished with a matching embroidered border. It comes with a contrast sea green blouse with embroidery on the sleeves and back. A good pick for weddings, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 7064 is a dusty rose pink saree with a soft shine, decorated with paisley motifs in beads work with green and pink stones. It has a scalloped golden embroidered border and a matching pink blouse with worked sleeves and neckline. A good pick for weddings, receptions, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 7666 is a rich pink saree with a soft satin-like shine, floral embroidered butties across the body and a scalloped cutwork border with flower embroidery. The matching pink blouse has small floral motifs on the back and sleeves. A good pick for weddings, receptions and festive party wear customers.

Saree design 7559 is a deep maroon saree covered in diagonal bands of golden embroidery with small multicolour flower motifs, finished with a golden floral border. It comes with a matching maroon blouse with embroidered sleeves and back. A good choice for weddings, receptions and festive wear customers.

Design 7551 is a bright rani pink saree with golden floral embroidery spread across the body and a rich golden scalloped border along the edges and pallu. It comes with a matching pink blouse with embroidered sleeves and a small motif on the back. A good pick for weddings, festivals and party wear customers.

Saree design 7560 comes in a rich magenta-wine colour with heavy golden embroidery in a wavy jaal pattern across the pallu and lower pleats, and small multicolour touches on the border. The matching blouse has the same work. A good choice for weddings, receptions and festive customers.

Saree design 7460 is a rich red saree with small golden embroidered butti set along fine diagonal lines all over the body. It has a wide floral embroidered border in cream, peach and blue with a scalloped edge, and a matching red blouse with embroidery on the back and sleeves. A good pick for weddings, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 6564 is a bright rani pink saree with white feather-shaped work motifs spread across the body. The border and pallu have a multicolour bandhani-style patchwork pattern in pink, green and mustard, with a matching printed blouse. It suits weddings, festivals and family functions, and customers who like rich festive looks.

Design 7594 is a bright yellow saree with a fine checks pattern and small dots, set off by broad red panels and a rich embroidered floral border. It comes with a plain red blouse with matching border work on the sleeves. A good pick for festivals, pujas, haldi and wedding functions.

Saree design 7426 is a sea green saree with a soft shimmer, decorated with embroidered peacock motifs all over and a silver-toned zari border. The pallu has a dark green panel with round peacock designs, matched with a dark green embroidered blouse. A good choice for weddings, receptions and festive wear.

Design 7427 is a peach-orange saree with a soft crushed shine, decorated all over with embroidered floral and elephant motifs. It has a silver-tone scroll border and a rich red pallu panel with round motifs, paired with a red blouse with golden butti work. A good pick for weddings, festivals and party wear customers.

Saree design 6759 is a bright rani pink saree with small shiny butti dots all over and a rich golden embroidered scalloped cut-work border. It comes with a maroon blouse with matching embroidery on the sleeves and back. A good pick for weddings, festivals and party wear customers who like a rich, festive look.

Design 6173 is a deep wine-purple saree with a plain body and a neat border of cream leaf motifs and small geometric blocks. The matching blouse has stone-style work on the neck and back, with the same leaf trim on the sleeves. A good pick for parties, festivals and family functions.

Design 7279 is a bright red saree with cream and golden thread embroidery of flowers, leaves and curling vines across the pallu, finished with a matching embroidered scalloped border. It comes with a red blouse with embroidered sleeves and back. A good pick for weddings, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 7473 is a rich green saree covered all over with golden floral jaal embroidery and finished with a golden scalloped border. It comes with a matching green blouse with small golden butti work. A good pick for weddings, receptions and festive functions, for customers who like a heavy, dressy party-wear look.

Saree design 7053 comes in a rich coffee-brown shade with a soft sheen, decorated with multicolour embroidered butta motifs and a heavy scalloped embroidered border. The matching V-neck blouse has small embroidered buttis. A good pick for weddings, receptions and festive parties.

Design 6823 is a soft lilac-pink saree with white embroidered leaf and paisley motifs spread across the body and larger paisleys along the pallu. It has a scalloped embroidered border and a matching blouse with small motifs and an embroidered sleeve edge. A good pick for parties, festivals and family functions.

Saree design 7474 is a soft pink saree covered in fine golden embroidery of small flowers and vines, with a wide scalloped golden border along the edge and pallu. It comes with a matching pink blouse with light work. A good choice for weddings, receptions, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 7113 is a dusty rose pink saree with colourful floral and vine embroidery in pink, orange and blue spread across the body and pallu. It has a wide golden embroidered scalloped border and a matching pink blouse with golden work on the sleeves. A lovely choice for weddings, receptions and festive functions.

Saree design 5812 is a soft pink saree with a gentle shimmer, decorated with golden embroidered leaf motifs all over and a wide golden embroidered border with a scalloped edge. It comes with a matching pink blouse with golden work on the neck and sleeves. A good pick for weddings, receptions and festive functions.

Saree design 7452 is a soft pink saree covered all over with light gold floral embroidery and small pink stone-like highlights, finished with a neat embroidered scalloped border. It comes with a deep wine blouse with small motifs on the back. A good pick for weddings, receptions and festive parties.

Design 6489 is a coral pink saree with a soft shimmer, covered in small embroidered floral butis and tiny stone dots. A wide border of leafy vine embroidery with a scalloped edge runs along the saree and pallu. The matching pink blouse has embroidered sleeves. Good for weddings, receptions and festive parties.

Saree design 6630 comes in a rich wine-purple shade with light-coloured floral embroidery running in diagonal creeper lines across the body. It has a wide embroidered border with a scalloped edge and a matching blouse with work on the sleeves and back. A good pick for weddings, receptions and festive wear.

Design 5150 is a soft pink saree with golden zari butta motifs spread across the body and tiny sparkle dots all over. A neat zari work border runs along the edges and pallu, with a matching pink blouse that has zari detail on the sleeves. A good pick for weddings, festivals and party wear customers.

Design 7123 is a bright pinkish-red saree with golden zari leaf motifs spread across the body and a wide golden zari border with a scalloped edge. The matching blouse carries the same zari work on the sleeves and small motifs on the back. It suits weddings, festivals and party wear customers.
